prior_verification.evidence: Official page: 220 seated with a dance floor, 240 seated without, 500 standing; 4,000 sq ft; large dance floor; separate break-out room; 135 free parking spaces; outside food adds $500. The page itself says 'pricing varies' (contact: Chuck, 301-518-4073). The 2026 contract PDF gives Saturday $3,000 for 8 contracted hours, extra hours $200, overtime $500/hr, holiday surcharge $1,000, and a $500 non-refundable deposit applied to the rent.
